The Human-IST Institute (Prof. Denis Lalanne, University of Fribourg, Switzerland) is seeking two PhD students in HCI starting as soon as possible.

PhD 1 — Distributed Presence in Buildings How can buildings become active mediators of human presence across distance? This PhD designs multimodal, embodied architectures operating across presence gradation, spatial anchoring, and AI mediation. Profile: Maker-type HCI researcher with skills in wearables, sensors, and interactive displays.

PhD 2 — Human-AI Co-Exploration & Visualization in Design How can humans and AI jointly navigate complex, multi-stakeholder design spaces through interactive trade-off visualization? This PhD investigates interactive intelligence applied to participatory design contexts, with building renovation as a primary deployment case. Profile: CS/HCI with interest in visualization and LLMs. No domain expertise in architecture required.

Both positions are embedded in the Smart Living Lab network (University of Fribourg + EPFL) with international partners in the US and Japan. Publications expected at CHI, CSCW, UIST, TOCHI, TEI.

Start: as soon as possible. Applications reviewed from April 1st, 2026. Full descriptions & application:
